title: ID0411108-DC/Si-D/DK[170001811] - Converter_Group_DC3 & DC4
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
DC3 and DC4 Converters not Found → E52 → Fast shutdown not performed correctly
Solution:
DC3 and DC4 wiring coming to FA10/FA11 were swapped → rewire correctly
Note to Warranty Manager → we didn't confirm if KF214 was actually faulty or not, so not elegible for warranty

additional_info.body:
Dear Martin,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R5 170001811
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
U9Dn7E
Problem Description
: DC3 and DC4 out of order due to Fast shutdown error with DC3/DC4 groups
Troubleshooting
: As we already tested, we tried replacing the KF214 and didn't work. Next we checked that the 12V are indeed coming out of the KF214 at the right time and not constantly ON.
With the assistance of João
we checked the DebugStation and found that the DC3 group was not doing the fast shutdown at the right time so it was clear that there was some kind of miswiring in the fast shutdown coming from the dispenser to the main charger.
When we swapped the cables everything worked properly.
If you are happy with our support please when you are filling the feedback survey don't forget to include João's amazing support.
I have to create a ticket for him to report his hours as well, so you might receive 1 more email.
For future reference, your case number is
0411108
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
